about: The P9's fresh magazine as a player action's prop (docs/dev/p9_reload_inspect_v1.md 3): the gun's own mag_out bone, drawn by the gun renderer where the action places this prop (gun_part); its frame is the gun's (the magazine seated when it sits on the gun prop unturned), same scale. Points: top (the magazine pivot), base (the base plate). Written by tools/author-p9-01-reload-actions.mjs.
